notes.sowing: Plant nursery plants or rooted cuttings in spring once the soil has warmed, at least {cm:45} apart. Seed is very slow and takes years to give a usable plant.
notes.care: Needs full sun and light, free-draining soil. Established plants survive about {c:-8} but not hard winters; where winters are colder, grow it in a pot at least {cm:30} wide and bring it into a cool, bright room before frost, keeping the compost on the dry side.
notes.harvest: Snip shoot tips as needed; it is evergreen, so picking can go on year round. Soft new growth has the best flavor, and regular cutting keeps the plant compact.
